type.description: Type of grant. A ConsumableGrant can be used once, for example to carry out a change of energy supplier, and becomes Exhausted when used. A PersistentGrant stays valid until validTo, or indefinitely if validTo is null, unless it is revoked.

status.description: Status of the grant. Pending: not yet valid. Active: valid. Exhausted: used. Expired: past validTo. Revoked: withdrawn.

scopes.description: Scopes describing what the grantedTo agent is authorized to do.
